crossRefs.note: There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.
so am I made to possess months of misery, wearisome nights are appointed to me.
I loathe my life. I don’t want to live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.
“My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.
My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.
My son, don’t despise Yahweh’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;
for whom Yahweh loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
The Lord Yahweh has given me the tongue of those who are taught, that I may know how to sustain with words him who is…
Therefore I also have struck you with a grievous wound. I have made you desolate because of your sins.
and the Sabeans attacked, and took them away. Yes, they have killed the servants with the edge of the sword, and I…
when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,

translations.web: But now, God, you have surely worn me out. You have made all my company desolate.
translations.bsb: Surely He has now exhausted me; You have devastated all my family.
translations.kjv: But now he hath made me weary: thou hast made desolate all my company.
translations.asv: But now he hath made me weary: Thou hast made desolate all my company.
